questions.questionHTML: Which of the following best encapsulates the primary function of AI in "pharmacovigilance" as described in the passage?
questions.passageHTML:
Generative Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare & Clinical Pharmacovigilance

The integration of Generative AI (GenAI) into healthcare systems is rapidly transitioning from theoretical promise to clinical deployment. Large clinical foundation models trained on electronic health records (EHRs), radiological imagery, and biochemical datasets have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in augmenting diagnostic precision. Particularly in pharmacovigilance—the detection, assessment, and prevention of adverse drug reactions—AI algorithms can parse vast real-world telemetry across hospital networks to identify drug interactions weeks before conventional statistical monitoring triggers alerts.

However, the deployment of autonomous clinical tools introduces profound regulatory, ethical, and epistemological challenges. Foremost among these is the "hallucination" phenomenon, wherein neural networks fabricate plausible-sounding yet physiologically errant diagnostic pathways. In life-critical contexts, such errors pose catastrophic risks. Furthermore, algorithmic bias arising from homogeneous demographic cohorts in training datasets can perpetuate diagnostic inequities across underrepresented populations.

To mitigate these liabilities, global regulatory authorities including the WHO and FDA advocate for the "Human-in-the-Loop" (HITL) paradigm. Under this framework, AI serves exclusively as a decision-support copilot, ensuring that final therapeutic determinations and liability remain vested with credentialed medical practitioners.

questions.questionHTML: Question 32: Two varieties of rice costing ₹60/kg and ₹85/kg are mixed in the ratio 3 : 2. If the mixture is sold at ₹77/kg, find the profit percentage.
questions.explanationHTML:
Cost price of 5 kg = 3*60 + 2*85 = 180 + 170 = ₹350. CP per kg = 350 / 5 = ₹70/kg.
Selling price = ₹77/kg. Profit = 77 - 70 = ₹7/kg.
Profit % = (7 / 70) * 100 = 10%.

questions.questionHTML: Who among the following attended the conference on the 27th of June?
questions.passageHTML:
Month & Date Arrangement: 8 Bankers

Eight bank executives (P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, and W) attended international banking conferences in four different months—March, April, May, and June—on two different dates: 14th and 27th of each month.

  • P attended the conference on the 14th of a month having 30 days.
  • Only two persons attended between P and S.
  • W attended immediately before S on the same month or different month.
  • R attended in May on an even-numbered date.
  • Q attended before R but after W.
  • Only one person attended between U and V.
questions.explanationHTML: Completing the calendar grid, executive T attended on the 27th of June.
